objective: State the strongest safe local validation claim for the v0.9.0 skill-quality learning-loop first milestone.
scope: receipt v1/v2 compatibility and local proposal, revision, migration, and tombstone state
closed evaluation-manifest contract and manual pilot scaffold
accepted component-map, package, engine, skill validation, and offline conformance identities

evidence_items.observed_summary: The post-acceptance Windows run executed 263 repository tests: 262 passed and one generic symlink test was skipped because link creation is privilege-dependent.

Sixty-two focused tests passed for v1/v2 receipts, content-free context and signatures, receipt-keyed proposal identity, analyzer revisions, order-independent state migration, no-action tombstones, distinct receipt and frozen-taxonomy evaluation binding, the closed evaluation manifest, and contribution compatibility.
The official local skill validator accepted the packaged analyzer.
The offline conformance fixture committed one local proposal, deduplicated replay, and performed no outbound action.
The synthetic evaluation manifest and pilot scaffold validate against the closed contract, while readiness remains INCONCLUSIVE because no representative model run was performed.
The v0.9.0 package matches its rebuilt manifest and recorded package digest.
The embedded component-evidence 1.3.0 engine identity verified.
Owner-accepted component-map-a2e9cfaad704 passed an unchanged reconciliation and preflight with its exact map identity.

claims.statement: On this Windows host, the local v0.9.0 release-candidate tree passed 262 of 263 repository tests with one privilege-dependent symlink skip, the official skill validator, package and engine verification, accepted-map preflight, and offline replay-safe quality-loop conformance with no outbound action. The first learning-loop milestone provides v1/v2 content-free receipts, one proposal identity per exact receipt with analyzer revisions, order-independent local state migration, bounded no-action tombstones, and a closed evaluation-manifest and manual-pilot scaffold with distinct exact-receipt and frozen-taxonomy binding. A representative pilot, measured quality improvement, trusted mechanical repair controller, remote CI, release, installation, and activation remain unobserved or unimplemented.
claims.rationale: The local protocol, exact candidate bytes, schemas, state behavior, and non-outbound conformance are directly tested, while learning quality, controller enforcement, and release lifecycle outcomes remain separate future gates.

limitations.text: The unpinned synthetic manifest and schema tests do not prove representative pilot performance, false-cluster rate, reproducibility across model runs, or quality improvement.
The local receipt, proposal, revision, and tombstone contract does not implement a trusted attempt ledger, mechanical cycle accounting, termination authority, or an autonomous repair controller.
Local tests and accepted-map preflight do not prove commit-bound pull-request or exact-main CI, release publication, managed installation, client routing, or fresh activation.

unresolved_uncertainties: Commit-bound pull-request and exact-main CI have not run for v0.9.0.
The representative ten-to-twenty-receipt pilot has not run, so clustering and quality-lift claims remain unmeasured.
A trusted attempt ledger, mechanically enforced cycle and termination controller, and autonomous repair loop are not implemented.
The v0.9.0 GitHub release, managed installation, and fresh activation do not exist.
Codex and Claude routing, discovery, and invocation remain host-controlled and unobserved for v0.9.0.
